name: api
title: Serverless API (Vercel functions)
summary: A typed api/ folder of Vercel functions with JSON, origin, crypto and IP-hash helpers.
when: The site needs ANY server-side code: a form that stores or emails, a secret key, a database, payments, auth. Every backend pack builds on this.
next: Run `npm run dev:api` (Vercel CLI) in one terminal and `npm run dev` in another; Vite proxies /api to it.
Add a route: create api/<name>.ts exporting a default (req, res) handler. Helpers live in api/_http.ts and api/_crypto.ts.
